row.notes: cmp rax,0x12 ; ja 0x14181465a: head of the inlined upgrade type switch in the upgrade card binder 0x141814320 (rax = type). Placing the hook on the head instead of the default 0x14181465a (lea r8,["INVALID UPGRADE"]) is a choice: a redirect from the head leaves every register as the default path does (only the jump-table dispatch writes rax/rcx), and the join (lea rdx,[fmt] ; lea rcx,[buf] ; call Ne_Format_String) reads only r8. rnd-tyres sets r8 = its type suffix for 19..22 and jumps to the join; other types fall through

verify.notes: V0044 movzx eax,[r14+0x70] ; cmp rax,0x12 ; ja 0x14181465a (6 bytes) head; default is lea r8 'INVALID UPGRADE'; join only reads r8 (rax/rcx clobbered by call). Note: rationale 'default has no unique signature' is inaccurate (a head-to-default pattern 0x141814633..0x141814661 is unique), harmless
